mapper.select: SELECT s.SUBMISSION_ID, s.ASSIGNMENT_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.CONTENT, s.FILE_NAME, s.SUBMITTED_AT, s.SCORE, s.FEEDBACK, s.STATUS_CD FROM TB_SUBMISSION s WHERE s.SUBMISSION_ID = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SUBMISSION (ASSIGNMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, CONTENT, FILE_NAME) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{content}, #{fileName})
